description.fr-FR: Les petits écrits spirituels de Bossuet : Discours sur la vie cachée en Dieu, questions et réponses aux Visitandines de Meaux, méthodes d’oraison en foi et en simplicité, exercice de la sainte messe, préparation à la communion, retraite de dix jours, discours sur la mort, actes d’abandon. Édition Lachat (1863).
description.en-US: Bossuet’s shorter spiritual writings: the Discourse on the Life Hidden in God, questions and answers for the Visitandines of Meaux, methods of prayer in faith and simplicity, the exercise of the Holy Mass, preparation for communion, a ten-day retreat, a discourse on death, acts of abandonment. Lachat edition (1863).
description.pt-BR: Os pequenos escritos espirituais de Bossuet: Discurso sobre a vida escondida em Deus, perguntas e respostas às Visitandinas de Meaux, métodos de oração na fé e na simplicidade, exercício da santa missa, preparação para a comunhão, retiro de dez dias, discurso sobre a morte, atos de abandono. Edição Lachat (1863).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume VII, pages 028 and 030-032. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
